symptoms: Concentric dark brown rings ('target board' pattern) on mature leaves
Yellow halo surrounding brown necrotic spots
Stem lesions near soil line leading to collar rot

treatment_protocol.organic: Apply copper-based fungicide or neem oil solution every 7-10 days
treatment_protocol.chemical: Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb application upon first symptom appearance
treatment_protocol.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops, drip irrigation to avoid wet foliage, staking plants
